# The SIX-AUTHORITY PARITY PROOF (design 13.8a, 13.15.2's N2 row). For each
# frame and each planning authority: what the authority contributes to the
# plan, what the derived requirement rows name, and what retiring the
# authority would LOSE. Question IDs only -- no corpus text.
#
# `lost` = contributed \ derived. It is the only column that decides a
# retirement: empty means the derived rows already name everything the
# authority supplies. `gained` = derived \ contributed, the plan.fact_kinds
# GROWTH design 13.9 B9 predicts -- reported, never asserted away.
#
# Source 5 is SPLIT into 5a (the declared per-cohort-kind table, which a
# frame determines) and 5b (edge-derived, which no frame determines).
# Folding them together would report the reproducible half as unreproducible.
